messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>

Subject: Post-demo: MAP draft + SDK/streaming integration milestones (FinOps AI)

Hi Sofia / Mike —

Thanks again for taking the demo today. Per our run-through, I captured the high-level Mutual Action Plan (MAP) milestones focused on the integration work your engineering team will need and the items Redwood will deliver. Attached is a first-pass MAP PDF (v0.2) and an SDK checklist we mentioned.

Key asks / next steps:
- Please confirm target close date that your procurement needs (we proposed 2027-01-12 as a close target).
- Confirm the internal owners on your side for SDK integration, streaming validation, and security sign-off.
- Review the dependency list in the MAP and call out any additional compliance checks (SOC2 artifacts, IP controls) we should surface now.

Short summary of the MAP milestone we discussed (Integration Roadmap):
1) SDK integration (Client dev): FinOps to implement Redwood JS/TS SDK (auth, batching) — owner: FinOps Eng Lead — target: 2 weeks after PO.
2) Streaming + KV cache flow (Low-latency chat): Redwood to enable streaming tokens + example app, FinOps to validate in staging — owner: Redwood Eng (Karthik) / FinOps SRE — target: end of week 3.
3) Tool calling + structured outputs (billing parser, invoice tool): design doc -> Redwood-provided tool-calling hooks + example agents -> integration test — owners: FinOps Integrations + Redwood Solutions (Monica) — target: week 4.
4) Production cutover & rollback plan: coordinated smoke tests, canary, and fallback model routes — joint owners — target: week 6.

I attached the MAP (v0.2) with milestone-level responsibilities and an SDK integration checklist. I will follow up with a cleaned MAP in Google Docs once you confirm owners and the close date.

If you want to tighten the timeline, we can propose a short accelerated plan that focuses only on streaming + tool-calling as an MVP.

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jordan@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0183

Subject: Re: Post-demo: MAP draft + SDK/streaming integration milestones (FinOps AI)

Thanks Jordan — good session. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 

- Procurement / legal: target close date is tentatively 2027-01-20 (we have an internal budget review the week of 2026-12-15). Can you live with that as an initial close?
- Owners: Eng lead will be Mike Thompson (cc'd). SRE will be Lina Gomez (lina@finops.ai) for staging validation; I'll be the product owner for the integration.
- Compliance: we will need SOC2 Type II evidence and a data retention statement early in the MAP; can you add those artifacts to the doc?

Also, two technical questions for the integration checklist: 
1) For streaming, do you support partial-token streaming with client-side reconstruction (we need messages displayed incrementally in our UI)?
2) For tool calling, can Redwood's structured outputs be constrained to a JSON schema and rejected if they don't match?

I'll review the attachments this afternoon and share feedback.

Sofia Ruiz
Head of Product, FinOps AI
sofia@finops.ai | +1 617-555-1039
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ruiz <sofia@finops.ai>, Mike Thompson <mike@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-16T08:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: MAP draft + SDK/streaming integration milestones (FinOps AI)

Sofia — great, thanks for the owners and the procurement timeline. A few quick answers + updated asks inline.

- Target close: 2027-01-20 is fine. I'll update the MAP timeline to shift the close date and push the production cutover accordingly.
- Compliance artifacts: we'll add SOC2 Type II summary, data retention statement, and an audit-log sample to the MAP attachments (new version v0.3 once we confirm).

Technical answers: 
1) Streaming behavior: Yes — Redwood supports incremental (partial-token) streaming to the client. The SDK exposes a streaming callback that yields token deltas; clients can reconstruct/display as tokens arrive. We'll include a small React example in the SDK checklist.
2) Structured outputs & schema enforcement: Redwood supports constrained structured outputs via schema-first validation. You can provide a JSON Schema (or OpenAPI schema) for the tool response; if the model output doesn't validate, Redwood can either reject (error) or return the raw output plus a validation failure flag — configurable per-route. We'll add the schema enforcement option to the MAP.

Attachment notes: I've uploaded a quick integration checklist spreadsheet with suggested code snippets and a proposed acceptance test matrix. Please review the 'acceptance criteria' column and confirm which tests you'll own vs Redwood.

Next steps: 
- Sofia / Mike: confirm ownership for each acceptance criterion in the spreadsheet (deadline: 2026-11-20).
- Karthik: can you confirm Redwood owner availability for streaming demo and a one-hour integration workshop the week of 2026-11-29?
- Monica: please prepare the tool-calling example agent (billing parser) we can ship as reference to FinOps during the workshop.

Thanks —
Jordan
